authenticity_review: The image exhibits high photorealism in lighting and texture for the horses and giraffes. However, the koalas show significant structural artifacts: paws lack distinct digit definition (appearing fused/mitten-like), and the fur has an unnatural plastic/felt sheen rather than woolly texture. The 'black koala' concept is biologically impossible, contributing to an uncanny valley effect. While the scene composition is coherent, the anatomical simplification of the koala limbs reduces authenticity.

Koala paw anatomy simplified/fused (lack of distinct digits/claws)
